description: This file defines the admission plugin management system for Kubernetes, including plugin registration, initialization, and configuration handling.

classes.name: Plugins
classes.description: Manages registration and instantiation of admission plugins.

methods.name: NewPlugins
methods.description: Creates a new Plugins manager instance.

methods.name: Registered
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered plugin names.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new plugin factory with a given name.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Creates an instance of a registered plugin by name, with configuration.

methods.name: splitStream
methods.description: Splits a configuration stream into two copies.

methods.name: NewFromPlugins
methods.description: Creates an admission interface that enforces decisions of multiple plugins.

methods.name: InitPlugin
methods.description: Initializes a plugin instance by name with configuration.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates plugin initialization if it implements the interface.
